## Author checklist

- [ ] Commits are atomic and follow Conventional Commits.
- [ ] Documentation and evidence match the implemented behavior.
- [ ] No secret, client-confidential data, or private artifact is included.
- [ ] New dependencies are necessary, pinned through the lockfile, and reviewed.
- [ ] User-facing changes include relevant responsive and accessibility evidence.
- [ ] Required checks ran without an unexplained skip or bypass.
